findings.shape: Ten selected overlapping lateral shelves have continuous rounded margins and attached pore-bearing lower skins, with a connected woody context rather than a generic mushroom stem.
findings.surface: Orange upper interiors transition to broader sulphur-yellow margins; lower pore cues and original numerical fine relief distinguish the upper and fertile surfaces.
findings.movement: Stationary same shelves with an optional enlarged authored drift overlay. No mature-fruitbody resizing, growth, decomposition or airflow simulation.
findings.evidenceScope: The actual Rror photograph shows layered orange/yellow shelves. Selected Song et al.2018 phylogeny/key context warns that host and region separate members of the sulphureus complex. The picture is source-labelled, not independently redetermined to a narrow molecular concept.
corrections: Thickened the thin pale initial shelves, reduced excessive overlap and strengthened orange/yellow separation.
Rounded fan margins and corrected black lower-surface shading seen in actual underside captures.
findings.residual: Shelf spacing and pore placement remain too regular, some shelves intersect, and the model is less densely overlapping than the reference. Host/region-dependent species limits, fine pore anatomy, age and tissue optics remain unresolved or unmeasured.

assessmentRubric.identity: Accepted species-rank binomial; photograph source-labelled, unresolved complex/geographic scope explicit
assessmentRubric.shape: Distinct initial fruit-body/fertile-anatomy correction; allometry and fine structure unmeasured
assessmentRubric.surface: Original numerical pigment/relief; partly stylized and not calibrated tissue optics
assessmentRubric.movement: Nonmotile same body; enlarged authored drift overlay, no physiological/biomechanical validation

limits: Partly stylized, unmeasured original educational reconstructions. Fine anatomy, age variation, tissue optics, dimensions and physiology remain incomplete. Enlarged spore dots are a teaching overlay with authored timing, not measured release, Buller-drop mechanics or an airflow solver. No independent specialist validation, scientific certification or accuracy percentage.
